## Purse hotfix
Fixes the actual live diagnostic `Purse: §67,416,7§p§601 §e(+5)` with an empty `BlankFormat` score column. Minecraft skips the unsupported `§p` pair when rendering, but the mod's preliminary regex left it inside the amount and rejected the purse as malformed.

Matching and styled replacement now share Minecraft's own formatted-text decoder, including component boundaries and unsupported codes. The full balance is **7,416,701 coins**; the `(+5)` gain suffix stays separate and the raw ordering score is never added to the balance.

Existing display settings, green money/cookie text, original coin colours, manual currencies and the absence of a standalone HUD are preserved. Diagnostics now include decoded text and the installed mod version.

## Verification
The exact diagnostic regression was reproduced against the old code before the fix. **113 unit tests pass**, including all 17 new formatting regressions and the exact row under all 168 order/layout/visibility combinations. The real Fabric client also passes the exact BlankFormat/team-owner row checks and **120 settings/currency rendering frames**. Tests replay the supplied data; this is not a logged-in Hypixel playtest.

The attached JAR is the exact artifact from the successful build, not a rebuild. `SHA256SUMS` is included.

## Installation
Replace the old mod JAR with **coins-to-money-1.2.1.jar**. Keep only one version installed. Existing settings are retained; no configuration reset is required.

Requires Minecraft **26.1.2**, Java **25**, Fabric Loader **0.19.5+**, and Fabric API **0.155.3+26.1.2**. Mod Menu is optional. **K** opens settings; **O** toggles conversion.
